card.name: "the" before a clinician role
card.fires_on: The word "the" (or "prescribing") right after a verb or preposition, when the next word is likely a clinician such as clinician, anesthesiologist, practitioner or physician. It appears in label text addressed to the provider.

modes.label: The before provider
modes.description: "the" after alert, familiar to, or considered by, ahead of a clinician title.
